reasoningGenerationControls.label: Reasoning effort

options.label: None
options.description: Lowest latency. The model answers without allocating reasoning tokens.

options.label: Low
options.description: Uses a small reasoning budget for latency-sensitive work.

options.label: Medium
options.description: Balanced quality, latency, and token usage. This is the provider default.

options.label: High
options.description: Spends more reasoning tokens on difficult or multi-step work.

options.label: X-high
options.description: Uses extended reasoning for the hardest asynchronous work.

options.label: Max
options.description: Maximum exploration and verification, with the highest latency and token usage.

reasoningGenerationControls.description: Controls how many reasoning tokens the model may spend. Higher levels can improve complex work but increase latency and output-token cost.

reasoningGenerationControls.label: Reasoning mode

options.label: Standard
options.description: Normal execution for routine, latency-sensitive, or high-volume work.

options.label: Pro
options.description: Applies more model work before returning one final answer. It can improve difficult tasks but increases latency and billed token usage.

reasoningGenerationControls.description: Pro mode performs additional internal model work before returning a single answer. It is independent of reasoning effort and is available only on GPT-5.6.

reasoningGenerationControls.label: Response detail

options.label: Low
options.description: More concise answers while preserving the requested result.

options.label: Medium
options.description: Balanced response detail. This is the provider default.

options.label: High
options.description: More detailed explanations and supporting context.

reasoningGenerationControls.description: Controls the default amount of detail in the final answer. It does not change the reasoning budget.
